### Common Pre-Drinking Ingredients

- **Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium):** Alcohol increases fluid and electrolyte loss, so replenishing them helps address dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1_MWn7a2tS_QDWsxhOWSbPVWF5EU9o0XfWzp9GGNbWmBB81tckkX_gtsEX9AvYIZhm2eSzxjAmdUYFugIxV3q5jnpc2f0qlWErNKjXNiWDiL_eYluJthsJj46_mWhBfen_-Zm-HiLGfhw0pdf9rvC7pI4iG32BgX2ei5ePnlcdD1q7jl6mLWZEf2-JR9eeI)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)
- **N-acetylcysteine (NAC) and glutathione:** Used to support antioxidant levels and liver detoxification pathways.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1zeQXr4rfu1BXxHycYNIvjdmhEsyEv-3G5YQ_OotFLa21nudce0tlFwtB4PqiVluqZNrpd0SdiowmYLMsRDTObHZUlvg16PQJJK4qhXTvffl37ASH6u-TSCqrZLnG2njhfXvKF7py2q3FlKniorAD5WLcv2-zFFSixEIDA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/m9UVG95itgI)
- **Dihydromyricetin (DHM) and milk thistle:** Frequently included in pre-drinking blends for liver and recovery support, though human clinical proof for hangover prevention remains weak.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXDrd0pRp0MEPVIP2O5VAuqBhPupIE_rpQT_VBiqjYjo5N3XD_yuusZjORUbzMyZenQkso_GCqcurhcvaO2_9Emh7bVLEM0Vjxi5sq_ILjNwniRS5IPrWZRU3eLghJqzzDH_-r6BwToMytbuC871ebGIkKhXc28YS2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1yvJaYzdeeeqhP--I-vI_puwMeJhYgEgqvIy7uUGhkx4ZiXBuxaJ1t6lMmD-ctwZpi6HDfWVHNUaWbLIOubrsu6FWdgQVh7Ozn3-wSodHsw37BLZAHfODHMBcu0Pn-FHW0w8RU5yccabSsHe0P75aE91HG6lQ55VcO1i9X9uQJKPS0n-7w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1zeQXr4rfu1BXxHycYNIvjdmhEsyEv-3G5YQ_OotFLa21nudce0tlFwtB4PqiVluqZNrpd0SdiowmYLMsRDTObHZUlvg16PQJJK4qhXTvffl37ASH6u-TSCqrZLnG2njhfXvKF7py2q3FlKniorAD5WLcv2-zFFSixEIDA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXf9FefZUuC3tQ9zIZ70cs2o6z0b9UkqCxA8LHM-vL3kDB3QwZZkOcZ4NYNDUzwXSrlzSASgVsqKT_YA6pKlt-gqLyZFw8sFC38-mWa_fPHfrmgDdC3bVf5pd35_mAHwXZoo1tbA)
- **B vitamins:** Alcohol depletes B vitamins and interferes with absorption, though taking them beforehand has not been proven to prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1_MWn7a2tS_QDWsxhOWSbPVWF5EU9o0XfWzp9GGNbWmBB81tckkX_gtsEX9AvYIZhm2eSzxjAmdUYFugIxV3q5jnpc2f0qlWErNKjXNiWDiL_eYluJthsJj46_mWhBfen_-Zm-HiLGfhw0pdf9rvC7pI4iG32BgX2ei5ePnlcdD1q7jl6mLWZEf2-JR9eeI)
- **Targeted probiotics:** Products like [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXkyBplAXW7ohltkn8PXSNGLyj4zj3SRm6kb2Dia5dtWxNx2j1V_nBWY5O2XVlXm6G0xQbB_L2EF1rBK-P_CdxNvXArV4F_jsWJCTKDjljtJArz2rCMsOfCENJMnDl2Q) use engineered *Bacillus subtilis* taken before drinking to break down acetaldehyde in the gut, while [Morning Recovery](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsAEBxCJF1xKKzT-jcTuYfsnRbtxb5PjqHf-2aekQpapp0cc9ZEecY2Ezu_Ayr1RmngM4ClI81gP6NHN9DYF-Ib3Npv95EQ8A-fGK49MNC16z_4nHl327HfS4uReTGGfeU3BRZyRMQZ07Z4Lg_eH1d5lqvO3f5mRi-0fZi2BxxS-Go7ricPsuGmo9_MVTGNsbD3CP2iu57hb-stHUkG99gs97Sk2cGyQFq_4N3riZaMXqfQ) combines hydration and recovery ingredients for before or during drinking. As covered by [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1yvJaYzdeeeqhP--I-vI_puwMeJhYgEgqvIy7uUGhkx4ZiXBuxaJ1t6lMmD-ctwZpi6HDfWVHNUaWbLIOubrsu6FWdgQVh7Ozn3-wSodHsw37BLZAHfODHMBcu0Pn-FHW0w8RU5yccabSsHe0P75aE91HG6lQ55VcO1i9X9uQJKPS0n-7w) , controlled trials show limited overall proof that these products prevent hangovers, and [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXDrd0pRp0MEPVIP2O5VAuqBhPupIE_rpQT_VBiqjYjo5N3XD_yuusZjORUbzMyZenQkso_GCqcurhcvaO2_9Emh7bVLEM0Vjxi5sq_ILjNwniRS5IPrWZRU3eLghJqzzDH_-r6BwToMytbuC871ebGIkKhXc28YS2) notes that hydration, food, and moderation remain primary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXkyBplAXW7ohltkn8PXSNGLyj4zj3SRm6kb2Dia5dtWxNx2j1V_nBWY5O2XVlXm6G0xQbB_L2EF1rBK-P_CdxNvXArV4F_jsWJCTKDjljtJArz2rCMsOfCENJMnDl2Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXB6riBdYbYy2msraVaZJF-Z2a2aPwznj-n78lCwhMMNQf-Rpn9pFj2hQ-oiRcAQBGarDnx1Us5zSEb5dS44uy1F6My7latCnpaKMvPwE4MgKGfbKqz9Y78O2yGlh7weU_Zl7l5bU-m66FBw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1yvJaYzdeeeqhP--I-vI_puwMeJhYgEgqvIy7uUGhkx4ZiXBuxaJ1t6lMmD-ctwZpi6HDfWVHNUaWbLIOubrsu6FWdgQVh7Ozn3-wSodHsw37BLZAHfODHMBcu0Pn-FHW0w8RU5yccabSsHe0P75aE91HG6lQ55VcO1i9X9uQJKPS0n-7w)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXDrd0pRp0MEPVIP2O5VAuqBhPupIE_rpQT_VBiqjYjo5N3XD_yuusZjORUbzMyZenQkso_GCqcurhcvaO2_9Emh7bVLEM0Vjxi5sq_ILjNwniRS5IPrWZRU3eLghJqzzDH_-r6BwToMytbuC871ebGIkKhXc28YS2)

### Safety Notes

- **Avoid acetaminophen:** Do not take acetaminophen before or while drinking due to liver stress and toxicity risk.
- **Food and pacing matter most:** Eating a balanced meal beforehand and pacing drinks slow alcohol absorption more reliably than pills.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1yvJaYzdeeeqhP--I-vI_puwMeJhYgEgqvIy7uUGhkx4ZiXBuxaJ1t6lMmD-ctwZpi6HDfWVHNUaWbLIOubrsu6FWdgQVh7Ozn3-wSodHsw37BLZAHfODHMBcu0Pn-FHW0w8RU5yccabSsHe0P75aE91HG6lQ55VcO1i9X9uQJKPS0n-7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1zeQXr4rfu1BXxHycYNIvjdmhEsyEv-3G5YQ_OotFLa21nudce0tlFwtB4PqiVluqZNrpd0SdiowmYLMsRDTObHZUlvg16PQJJK4qhXTvffl37ASH6u-TSCqrZLnG2njhfXvKF7py2q3FlKniorAD5WLcv2-zFFSixEIDA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1_MWn7a2tS_QDWsxhOWSbPVWF5EU9o0XfWzp9GGNbWmBB81tckkX_gtsEX9AvYIZhm2eSzxjAmdUYFugIxV3q5jnpc2f0qlWErNKjXNiWDiL_eYluJthsJj46_mWhBfen_-Zm-HiLGfhw0pdf9rvC7pI4iG32BgX2ei5ePnlcdD1q7jl6mLWZEf2-JR9eeI)

items.title: Common Pre-Drinking Ingredients
items.text: Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium): Alcohol increases fluid and electrolyte loss, so replenishing them helps address dehydration. N-acetylcysteine (NAC) and glutathione: Used to support antioxidant levels and liver detoxification pathways. Dihydromyricetin (DHM) and milk thistle: Frequently included in pre-drinking blends for liver and recovery support, though human clinical proof for hangover prevention remains weak. B vitamins: Alcohol depletes B vitamins and interferes with absorption, though taking them beforehand has not been proven to prevent hangovers. Targeted probiotics: Products like ZBiotics use engineered Bacillus subtilis taken before drinking to break down acetaldehyde in the gut, while Morning Recovery combines hydration and recovery ingredients for before or during drinking. As covered by TIME, controlled trials show limited overall proof that these products prevent hangovers, and WIRED notes that hydration, food, and moderation remain primary.
